AAI SSCO Consultant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 39 Posts - Complete Details

The Airports Authority of India (AAI) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 39 Consultant. The online application opens on 17-09-2026, and closes on 01-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through AAI website, aai.aero.

Important Dates

  • Eligible Candidates : Retired Short Service Commission Officers of the Indian Army, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, or Indian Coast Guard
  • Opening Date for Submission of Applications (by email) : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date for Submission of Application : 1 October 2026
  • Eligible Candidates : Retired Short Service Commission Officers of the Indian Army, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, or Indian Coast Guard

Application Fee

  • Total Posts : 39
  • Last Date for Submission of Application : 1 October 2026
  • Interview Schedule : Will be intimated later, only on the registered email ID of shortlisted candidates
  • Post Code : Location-wise Requirement

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
